Vendored, offline build dependencies:

- json.hpp: nlohmann/json v3.11.3, https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3, MIT (json_LICENSE.MIT).
- picosha2.h: okdshin/PicoSHA2 commit 161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29, https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2, MIT (license in header).

Used for JSON manifests and streaming SHA-256. Build does not download these files.
